shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js'; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css && git diff -- package.json && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|NextApi(Request|Response)' app components lib && rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)(-core)?/package.json"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts && node -e 'const m = require(\"./.next/prerender-manifest.json\"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: m.routes, dynamicRoutes: m.dynamicRoutes }, null, 2))'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)[\\x27\\x22]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|NextApi(Request|Response)' app components lib tests; test "'! -d pages'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json .gitignore'
